statements.impact_statement: CVE-2024-1013 is a 4-byte/8-byte length-variable mismatch in the sample PostgreSQL driver bundled in the unixODBC source tree (Drivers/Postgre7.1/info.c), fixed upstream in https://github.com/lurcher/unixODBC/commit/45f501e1be2db6b017cc242c79bfb9de32b332a1 (https://github.com/lurcher/unixODBC/pull/157, released in 2.3.13); the fix touches only that driver file. unixODBC's configure builds the bundled drivers only with --enable-drivers (default no), and the Debian 2.3.12-2+deb13u1 source this owner is rebuilt from configures without it. We unpacked every package built from the unixodbc source in the DHI Debian repository, amd64 and arm64, including the -dbgsym packages: they hold the libodbc, libodbcinst and libodbccr shared libraries, their static .a archives in unixodbc-dev (driver manager, installer and cursor-library objects only), and the isql, iusql and odbcinst programs. No PostgreSQL driver library or object is present. Debian reaches the same conclusion: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2024-1013
